author: Ortea, 2001

note.en: A tiny sea slug (nudibranch) of the genus Doto that feeds on hydroids. Known from survey samples at Punta Mona and Manzanillo, 8 to 25 m (2000 to 2002). Too small for most divers to notice, and its exact length was not found, so 1.4 cm is a ceiling from its relatives here.
note.es: Una babosa de mar diminuta (nudibranquio) del género Doto que se alimenta de hidroides. Conocida de muestras en Punta Mona y Manzanillo, 8 a 25 m (2000 a 2002). Demasiado pequeña para que la noten la mayoría de los buzos, y no se encontró su largo exacto, así que 1,4 cm es un tope según sus parientes locales.

evidence: GBIF: survey records at Manzanillo and Punta Mona (1999 to 2002)
WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
